guide: Each group is one purpose. The tag before a purpose says where it comes from; a yellow tag means it was guessed from the code. Explain this copies a prompt: paste it to Claude for a deeper page on that part.
no_text: Binary file: no text to show.
excerpt_missing: This part of the file no longer exists.
no_code_help: The plan lists these for this stretch of work, but no change here carries them out. Either they are still to do, or they were done somewhere else.
generated_help: Written by code generators or package managers, not by hand; only their size is shown.
commits_label: Commits behind this group (messages as written):
mismatch_label: A claim does not match the code:

js.copy_failed: Copy failed: select the text and copy it
js.default_question: Explain this part in depth: what it does, why it changed, and what it touches.
js.question_placeholder: e.g. why here and not in the service?
js.paste_hint: Paste it to Claude, in this session or a new one.
js.keys_hint: Keys: j next · k previous · o fold or open
